Prime Minister Narendra Modi apologised for arriving late at the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur in West Bengal. Explaining the delay, Modi said bad weather disrupted his travel plans and even after travelling by road, he could not reach the venue on time. He was addressing students, faculty members and guests at the institute's 75th-anniversary celebrations. Watch
